judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and type names (`ListSessionsMessage` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, etc.). It completely omitted the required `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, making the feature always on by default in violation of the spec and GDPR requirements. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead of the required `UNSUPPORTED` error code, which the ticket explicitly forbade. It also failed to enforce the 1-200 range on `limit` in validation, leaked `error.message` in logs, and missed updating `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`.
